skill.name: cooper-sms
skill.description: Explain Cooper SMS availability and offer email alternatives for verification codes and owner alerts. This version does not provide phone numbers or text messaging.
skill.summary: Handle Cooper SMS requests with clear availability guidance and email alternatives.
skill.author: cooper-email

finding_verdicts.reason: The backticks format an API route in Markdown, not a shell expression. The surrounding instructions explicitly prohibit calling unavailable SMS routes.
The backticks identify an email skill and MCP tool after asking whether email verification is possible. No shell command or executable interpolation appears.
The backticks format the name of a separate email notification skill. This is conditional guidance for requested alerts, not shell execution.
The backticks format the MCP tool name cooper_notify_owner. No shell syntax, injected arguments, or unrequested invocation appears.
The HTTPS URL is homepage metadata pointing to Cooper SMS documentation. It contains no sensitive payload and does not instruct an automatic network request.
The first-party documentation link supports the statement that SMS is unavailable. No credential transfer or unrelated external destination is specified.
The first-party URL is presented as an optional account-owner opt-in page, not an instruction to submit information automatically. No unauthorized disclosure is evidenced.
The HTTPS changelog link identifies where a future launch will be announced. It does not request transmission of user data or credentials.

content.value_statement: Requests for Cooper phone numbers and text messages can rely on features that are not available in this version. This skill explains the limitation and directs suitable requests to email alternatives.
actual_capabilities: Explain that Cooper SMS phone numbers and message sending are unavailable in this version.
Direct verification requests to the separate email verification skill when the service supports email.
Direct requested owner alerts to the separate Cooper email notification skill.
Provide the account-owner SMS opt-in link without claiming it sends texts.
Identify the live MCP tool list and Cooper changelog as future launch references.
Preserve the requested provider unless the user requests an alternative.
limitations: Cannot provision phone numbers, send texts, or retrieve SMS verification codes.
Email verification and owner notifications require separate skills and available tools.
The documented SMS opt-in page stores consent but does not send texts yet.
Availability guidance reflects this skill version, not an independently verified live service check.

use_cases.title: Clarify Verification Options
use_cases.description: Explain why Cooper cannot receive an SMS code and ask whether the service supports email verification.

use_cases.title: Route Owner Alerts
use_cases.description: Handle a requested human alert by directing it to the existing Cooper email notification workflow.

use_cases.title: Find SMS Launch Information
use_cases.description: Provide the optional account-alert opt-in page and launch references without claiming that SMS is active.
use_cases.target_user: Account owners planning future SMS use

prompt_templates.title: Check SMS Support
prompt_templates.prompt: Can Cooper give my agent a phone number or send a text in this skill version?

prompt_templates.title: Find an Email Verification Alternative
prompt_templates.prompt: I need a verification code for [service]. Explain Cooper SMS availability and ask whether email verification is supported before choosing an alternative.

prompt_templates.title: Route a Requested Owner Alert
prompt_templates.prompt: Notify my Cooper account owner about [event]. Explain the SMS limitation and use the email notification workflow only if its tool is available.
prompt_templates.scenario: Owner notification through an existing integration

prompt_templates.title: Assess Future SMS Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare this skill's SMS limitation with the live MCP tool list, if accessible, and the Cooper changelog. Report uncertainty and avoid undocumented routes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced availability assessment with external access

output_examples.input: Get me a Cooper phone number for a verification code.
output_examples.output: Cooper phone numbers and SMS verification are unavailable in this skill version. Can the service send your verification code by email instead?

output_examples.input: Text my account owner about the failed job.
output_examples.output: Cooper SMS is unavailable in this version. I can use the separate email notification workflow if its tool is available.

output_examples.input: Where can I opt in to future Cooper SMS alerts?
output_examples.output: Account owners can opt in at https://cooperemail.com/sms. The page stores the opt-in but does not send a text yet.

best_practices: State the SMS limitation before proposing email alternatives.
Confirm email verification support and check that the required email tool is available.
Check the live MCP tool list and changelog before claiming that SMS has launched.
anti_patterns: Claiming that a phone number or SMS message was created.
Calling undocumented SMS tools or unavailable phone-number routes.
Switching to another SMS provider without a user request.

faq.question: Can this skill send or receive SMS?
faq.answer: No. This version states that Cooper SMS phone numbers and message sending are unavailable to customers.

faq.question: Can it help with verification codes?
faq.answer: It suggests email verification when supported and points to the separate cooper-agent-signup-otp skill and cooper_wait_for_code tool.

faq.question: How are account owners notified today?
faq.answer: The skill directs requested alerts to the separate cooper-owner-updates skill and cooper_notify_owner email tool.

faq.question: Does the SMS opt-in page send a text?
faq.answer: No. The skill states that https://cooperemail.com/sms stores account-owner opt-in for future alerts without sending a text yet.

faq.question: Will it choose another SMS provider automatically?
faq.answer: No. The skill instructs the assistant to retain Cooper unless the user requests another provider.

faq.question: How can I check for a future SMS launch?
faq.answer: Check the live MCP tool list and https://cooperemail.com/changelog. This skill does not provide a launch date.
